# Initial Setup 
First starting by importing the relevant datasets and loading the initial models.

```{r}
source(here::here("R", "functions.R"))
install_and_load_all_packages()
df <- read_csv(here::here("Data", "pollination_traits_dataset-scaled.csv"))

nutrient_order_levels <- c("Low","High")
water_order_levels <- c("Well-watered","Drought")
df$nutrient.x <- factor(df$nutrient.x, levels = nutrient_order_levels)
df$water.x  <- factor(df$water.x,  levels = water_order_levels)

# Pollinator Visitation Models (Without Traits) ----
## All Species ----
pv_model <- glmer.nb(Pollinator ~ nutrient.x * water.x * Species + N_nutrient + N_water + (1 | Block) + (1 | Individual_id), data = df)
## Individual Species ----
pvmodels_by_species <- df %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  setNames(unique(df$Species)) %>%
  map(~ glmer.nb(
    Pollinator ~ nutrient.x * water.x +
      N_nutrient +
      N_water +
      (1 | Block) +
      (1 | Individual_id),
    data = .x
  ))

# Pollinator Visitation Models (With Traits) ----
## All Species ----
traits_pv_model <- glmer.nb(Pollinator ~ nutrient.x * water.x * Species + 
  Plant_height_cm +
  sqrt_No_of_flowers +
  `log_Floral_area_mm^2` +
  Bee_chromatic_contrast +
  Fly_chromatic_contrast +
  Achromatic_contrast +
  Total_brightness +
  log_Chroma +
  Hue +
  N_nutrient + 
  N_water + 
  (1 | Block) + 
  (1 | Individual_id), data = df)
## Individual Species ----
traits_pvmodels_by_species <- df %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  setNames(unique(df$Species)) %>%
  map(~ glmer.nb(
    Pollinator ~ nutrient.x * water.x +
    Plant_height_cm +
    sqrt_No_of_flowers +
    `log_Floral_area_mm^2` +
    Bee_chromatic_contrast +
    Fly_chromatic_contrast +
    Achromatic_contrast +
    Total_brightness +
    log_Chroma +
    Hue +
    N_nutrient +
    N_water +
    (1 | Block) +
    (1 | Individual_id),
    data = .x
  ))
```

# Computing Variance Explained 

The full model with all fixed effects and random effects (Block and Individual) only seem to work for the "All Species" model (With the MuMIn package) whereas for the individual species models it would always return NA for both marginal R² and conditional R². This was consistent when done both using the MuMin::r.squaredGLMM() and performance::r2_nakagawa() function.

```{r}
# Using MuMin ----
MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(pv_model)
r2_by_species <- map(pvmodels_by_species, ~ purrr::possibly(
  function(mod) {
    MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(mod)
  },otherwise = NA  # return NA if computation fails
)(.x))
r2_table <- map_df(r2_by_species, function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) {
    tibble(R2m = NA_real_, R2c = NA_real_)
  } else {
    tibble(R2m = x[["R2m"]], R2c = x[["R2c"]])
  }
}, .id = "Species")

print(r2_table)

# Using Performance----
performance::r2_nakagawa(pv_model)
r2_by_species <- map(pvmodels_by_species, ~ purrr::possibly(
  function(mod) {
    performance::r2_nakagawa(mod)
  },
  otherwise = NA 
)(.x))
r2_table <- map_df(r2_by_species, function(x) {
  if (!inherits(x, "data.frame")) {  # check if x is a data frame
    tibble(R2m = NA_real_, R2c = NA_real_)
  } else {
    tibble(
      R2m = x$R2_marginal,
      R2c = x$R2_conditional
    )
  }
}, .id = "Species")
print(r2_table)

```

This is most probably due to the variance by one or both random effects being near zero. This is confirmed using the VarCorr() function.

```{r}
## Computing Contribution of Random Effects ----
### Model without traits ----
VarCorr(pv_model) # Contibution of Block is much lower 
varcorr_by_species <- map_dfr(
  pvmodels_by_species,
  extract_varcorr,
  .id = "Species"
)
varcorr_by_species # Contribution of Block is too less in ARA ARE, DIA DEL, LEU IRC, POT ARG. Contribution of both block and individual is 0 in VER CHA
### Models with traits ----
VarCorr(traits_pv_model) # Contibution of Block is lower but moth individual and block are closer to 0 than in without traits model
varcorr_by_species <- map_dfr(
  traits_pvmodels_by_species,
  extract_varcorr,
  .id = "Species"
)
varcorr_by_species # Contribution of both individual and block are much lower than 0
```

Removing one of the random effects (Block) doesnt help either as R² in VER CHA still ends up NA due to low variance of both Individual_id and Block

Removing both random effects changes the type of model from glmer.nb() to glm.nb() model. There is another problem even in this where if I change the model to this in the resulting ANOVA table all inidividual effects show NA.

Managed to compute marginal R² by creating a function for it. Here if any of the models are singular, ie any of the variance of random effects is near zero, it automatically returns marginal R² in place of conditional R² (which is reliant on random variance).

```{r}
### Function to compute approximate R² for a glmer.nb model  ----
compute_r2_approx <- function(mod) {
  # Check if model is singular
  singular <- isSingular(mod)
  
  # Predicted values from fixed effects only
  Xb <- predict(mod, re.form = NA)
  var_fixed <- var(Xb)
  
  # Total variance for negative binomial: var(Y) = var_fixed + residual variance
  theta <- getME(mod, "glmer.nb.theta")   # NB dispersion
  mu <- predict(mod, type = "response")   # fitted mean
  var_resid <- mean(mu + mu^2 / theta)    # residual variance
  
  R2m <- var_fixed / (var_fixed + var_resid)
  
  # Conditional R²
  if (singular) {
    R2c <- R2m  # no random effect variance
  } else {
    # Add random effect variance
    vc <- as.numeric(VarCorr(mod)[[1]])  # sum all random effect variances
    R2c <- var_fixed / (var_fixed + var_resid + vc)
  }
  
  return(tibble(R2m = R2m, R2c = R2c, Singular = singular))
}
### Computing Approx R2 for Models ----
#### Pollination Visitation Models (Without Traits) ----
# Full model
full_model_r2 <- compute_r2_approx(pv_model) %>%
  mutate(Species = "All Species") %>%
  select(Species, everything())

# Species-specific models
species_r2_no_traits <- map_dfr(names(pvmodels_by_species), function(spec) {
  mod <- pvmodels_by_species[[spec]]
  r2_vals <- compute_r2_approx(mod)
  r2_vals %>% mutate(Species = spec)
})

# Combine full + species models
all_r2_no_traits <- bind_rows(full_model_r2, species_r2_no_traits) %>%
  select(Species, everything())

# Export CSV
write_csv(all_r2_no_traits, "pv_model_all_r2_no_traits.csv")

#### Pollination Visitation Models (With Traits) ----
# Full model
full_model_traits_r2 <- compute_r2_approx(traits_pv_model) %>%
  mutate(Species = "All Species") %>%
  select(Species, everything())

# Species-specific models
species_r2_with_traits <- map_dfr(names(traits_pvmodels_by_species), function(spec) {
  mod <- traits_pvmodels_by_species[[spec]]
  r2_vals <- compute_r2_approx(mod)
  r2_vals %>% mutate(Species = spec)
})

# Combine full + species models
all_r2_with_traits <- bind_rows(full_model_traits_r2, species_r2_with_traits) %>%
  select(Species, everything())

# Export CSV
write_csv(all_r2_with_traits, "pv_model_all_r2_with_traits.csv")
```
